scope: Strict response contract for the private location-scoped nutrient balance aggregate endpoint.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at each response object level
constraints.season_and_crop_name: maximum 100 characters as defined by nutrient_budget schema
constraints.numbers: finite; null retained for absent aggregate values; signed semantics preserved
constraints.request_binding: response location_id, limit, and offset must match the request
constraints.pagination: has_more must agree with total_summaries, offset, and returned group count
constraints.validation: Explicitly validate the service projection before returning JSONResponse

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes the balances endpoint contract only; soil-test and nutrient-event response contracts and live populated-data parity remain separate work.
